```yaml
name: Publish Bulk CDK Extract Package
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish-extract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3

      - name: Validate Extract Version
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:checkExtractVersion

      - name: Publish Extract CDK
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:extractCdkPublish
```
